# Collection and downstream map context

Independently authored Java8 methods bind a collection element, classifier key
and downstream result to an invariant map result. The downstream accumulator
stays unbounded. The frozen observer checks exact incoming references, scalar
flags, original opaque actions, callback order, state identity, result identity,
late casts and failures. Source and SDK profiles compile every recovered unit
and compare original Signatures, roles, Exceptions and reported helpers. Private
application bytes and behavior are not used.
